label: Hebei transport: the 1966 Xingtai earthquake (M6.8) from USGS ShakeMap
description: The 1966 Xingtai earthquake's USGS ShakeMap: its median and uncertainty at each bridge, with ln SA correlated between bridges (Jayaram & Baker 2009, as OpenQuake applies to ShakeMaps). Sampling fetches the map (about 30 MB) unless it is cached.

bindings.note: ln SA at the bridges is one Gaussian field: the map's median and sigma at each bridge, correlated by this set (its period matches the IM). Swap for independent.any-im to see what the correlation changes.
